quarterly_data.signal: September 2026 monthly revenue (company report, unaudited): consolidated revenue of NT$1,158.6 billion, up 25.70% MoM and 38.42% YoY - the highest single-month revenue in the company's history and the first time monthly revenue surpassed NT$1 trillion (prior all-time monthly high NT$946.5 billion in July 2026). Q3 2026 revenue was NT$3,026.9 billion, up 20.44% QoQ and 47.12% YoY, the highest for the period; revenue for the first nine months of 2026 reached NT$7.67 trillion, up 39.53% YoY.

quarterly_data.signal: Segment drivers stated in the September 2026 revenue report: Cloud and Networking Products achieved significant growth MoM 'benefiting from strong pull-in momentum for AI products' and showed strong growth YoY in September, in Q3 2026 and year to date on pull-in momentum for AI products; Q3 2026 YoY ranking: Cloud and Networking Products > Components and Other Products > Computing Products > Smart Consumer Electronics.
